facts.fact: The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report lists e-filing among its services, with an income-returns e-filing season run for taxpayers from August to October 2022, and a Taxpayer Portal giving individuals 24/7 online services.
The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report says it collected 98% of tax receipts through e-payment.
The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report says it reached e-filing of tax returns in almost all cases.
